narrative_title: Architecture Library — Mies & the Barcelona Pavilion
narrative: The architecture library. On the shelves: Mies van der Rohe, Barcelona — the Barcelona Pavilion, that touchstone of modern space, its flowing planes and dissolved walls. A small but pointed collection that declares the center's architectural allegiances.
